text:
About **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** experienced tree-cover loss in 2022, equivalent to roughly 2.8% of the 17.6-hectare property.

The total mapped loss event was 0.6 hectares; the remaining 0.1 hectares was outside the national forest map. A further 0.2 hectares of tree-cover loss occurred in smaller patches, but its forest type is not specified.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish permanent deforestation or explain the cause.
